title.narrative: Regional Strategy Adopted for the implementation of SPF and comprehensive social security in Arab States

description.narrative: This CPO will support articulating social protection reforms with the expansion of decent jobs, in the Arab region. Despite differences in contexts, all countries grapple with transitioning from a social contract based on public employment and universal subsidies to one that delivers good jobs in the private sector and inclusive social protection safeguards. ILO (As a co-lead with UNICEF) of the Issue-Based Coalition (IBC) on social protection will have to play a critical role in supporting the implementation at the country level.
